# UX Library
#### A collection of web components built with Stencil that can be used to build user interfaces on multiple platforms.

## [Documentation](https://mackgame4.github.io/uxlibrary/)

## Contributing

To get started, run the following commands in your terminal:

```bash
npm install
npm start
```

This will install the necessary dependencies and start a local development server. You can now open the `index.html` file in your browser to view the components in action.

## Building

To build the components for production, run the following command:

```bash
npm run build
```

This will generate a `dist` directory with the components and assets ready to be deployed.

Then you can copy the `dist` directory to your project and import the components in your app:

```html
<script type="module" src="path-to-dist/uxlibrary/uxlibrary.esm.js"></script>
<script nomodule src="path-to-dist/esm/uxlibrary.js"></script>
```
